name: click

files.tests/test_cli.py:
from app import cli


def test_deploy_dry_run():
    result = cli.invoke(["deploy", "staging", "--tag", "a", "--tag", "b"])
    assert result.exit_code == 0
    assert result.output == "would deploy to staging [info] tags=a,b\n"


def test_deploy_level_case_insensitive():
    result = cli.invoke(["deploy", "production", "--no-dry-run", "--level", "DEBUG"])
    assert result.output == "deploying to production [debug] tags=\n"


def test_status_table_width():
    lines = cli.invoke(["status"]).output.splitlines()
    assert len(lines) == 2
    assert all(len(line) == cli.table_width() for line in lines)
    assert lines[1].endswith("degraded")


def test_complete_env():
    assert cli.complete_env(None, [], "pr") == ["production", "preview"]


def test_plugins_and_version():
    assert cli.invoke(["plugins", "hello", "bob"]).output == "hello bob\n"
    assert cli.invoke(["--version"]).output == "deployctl, version 1.2.0\n"


def test_smoke_returns_results():
    results = cli.smoke()
    assert [r.exit_code for r in results] == [0, 0]

ground_truth.breaks: AttributeError: module 'click' has no attribute 'get_terminal_size' (raised on first call, i.e. when table_width() runs)

verified.old: click 7.1.2 (py3.11): returns plain tuple (80, 24) when not a tty; no warning (-W error). It is click.termui.get_terminal_size, a wrapper, not shutil's function.
verified.new: click 8.1.8 and 8.5.1 (py3.12): AttributeError. shutil.get_terminal_size() returns os.terminal_size, equal to (80, 24) and unpacks the same, so the migrated app is identical.

ground_truth.breaks: TypeError: Parameter.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'autocompletion' (at import time, in the decorator)
ground_truth.source: Click 8.0.0 deprecated autocompletion in favour of shell_complete (callback now (ctx, param, incomplete)); 8.1.0 removed
ground_truth.note: The callback signature changes too (args -> param), so a pure keyword rename is not enough in general; here the callback does not use args.

verified.new: 8.1.8 and 8.5.1: TypeError at decoration time, so `import app.cli` fails; shell_complete=<callback(ctx, param, incomplete)> accepted

ground_truth.breaks: DeprecationWarning (8.1.8 and 8.5.1): 'MultiCommand' is deprecated and will be removed in Click 9.0. Use 'Group' instead. Still works in 8.x.
ground_truth.source: Click 8.2.0 changelog: BaseCommand/MultiCommand deprecated, removed in 9.0

verified.new: 8.5.1: subclass works, DeprecationWarning at class definition (Python-level warnings.warn). click.MultiCommand is NOT click.Group; subclassing click.Group with the same list_commands/get_command works on both 7.1.2 and 8.5.1.

ground_truth.breaks: invoking a click.Group with no arguments exits with code 2 instead of 0 (same usage text); the Result object is returned either way, only result.exit_code differs
ground_truth.source: Click 8.2.0 changelog: a group with no_args_is_help (the default) exits non-zero when invoked with no arguments

notes: Click 7.1.2 emits no warning for any entry (verified with -W error on py3.11): nothing at runtime predicts the get_terminal_size / autocompletion breaks (S4). The Result returned by app.cli.invoke / smoke / bare_invoke is a click.testing.Result (S1): it has exit_code/output/exception but no structural renderer, so the change scenario (exit_code 0 -> 2, output text identical) is only visible if verify compares Result attributes, not just its type; the weak test checks 'Usage:' in result.output and stays green on both. Identical-behaviour check: for smoke() and invoke() of plugins hello / --version / deploy --level DEBUG / deploy (missing arg), original app on 7.1.2 and migrated app on 8.5.1 give identical exit_code, output and exception types; migrated app also passes on 8.1.8 (6/6). The migrated run additionally has no DeprecationWarning (pytest -W error::DeprecationWarning). The click.MultiCommand deprecation is a Python-level warning only on the new side. Not in ground truth because the app does not touch it: CliRunner(mix_stderr=...) is removed in 8.2 (TypeError), and Result.stdout excludes stderr from 8.2 (7.1 mixes by default). Pin choice: 8.5.1 is the latest 8.x resolved on 2026-11-15; 8.1.8 gives the same results except the no-arg exit code (8.2 change).
